name: Pistachio Chocolate Chip Cookie

ingredients.name: kosher salt, plus more for sprinkling

instructions.primary_message: Chop the dark chocolate. Coarsely chop the roasted unsalted shelled pistachios. Soften the unsalted butter. Stir the pistachio cream well. Keep the egg cold until you use it.
instructions.secondary_message:
250 g dark chocolate
135 g roasted unsalted shelled pistachios
16 tbsp unsalted butter
140 g pistachio cream
1 large egg

instructions.primary_message: For the Cookie Dough: Adjust oven racks to upper-middle and lower-middle positions and preheat to 180°C (350°F). In a medium bowl, stir chopped chocolate and pistachios until combined. Sift flour on top of chocolate and pistachios. Set aside.

In a large bowl with a hand mixer, or in the bowl of a stand mixer fitted with a paddle attachment, mix butter, granulated sugar, brown sugar, vanilla, salt, baking soda, and baking powder on low speed to moisten dry ingredients, then increase to medium speed and beat, scraping sides of bowl as needed, until pale and fluffy, about 5 minutes.

Scrape sides of bowl. Add pistachio cream and beat on medium speed until well combined, about 30 seconds. With mixer running, add egg and continue to beat until just combined. Reduce speed to low, add reserved flour-pistachio mixture all at once, and mix until stiff dough forms, about 30 seconds.
To Portion Cookies: Divide cookie dough in 2-tablespoon portions (about 40 g; 43 g each) and round each portion into a smooth ball.

To Bake: Arrange 12 cookies on 2 parchment-lined rimmed baking sheets (6 cookies per sheet), leaving 5 cm between cookies. Top each cookie with a pinch of kosher salt. Bake until cookies are puffed and pale gold around the edges but still soft, 13 to 16 minutes, rotating pans back to front and top to bottom halfway through baking. For crunchy cookies, continue baking until golden, 3 to 5 minutes more. Cool directly on baking sheet until crumb is set, about 5 minutes. Repeat with remaining cookies, making sure that baking sheets have fully cooled before baking. Serve warm or allow to come to room temperature. Alternatively, portioned cookie dough can be refrigerated in a heavy-duty zipper-lock bag for up to 1 week or frozen for up to 6 months.

schema_metadata.keywords: cookies, chocolate chip cookies, pistachio cookies, pistachio chocolate chip cookies

description: These pistachio chocolate chip cookies are chewy, nutty, and perfectly balanced with dark chocolate.
notes:
Notes: Use a chopped bar of chocolate instead of chips. Chocolate chips are formulated to hold their shape during baking, while chopped chocolate melts more freely, creating irregular pockets and streaks of melted chocolate throughout the cookie.
Look for a pistachio cream that's sweet and smooth but still tastes distinctly of pistachio.
As the cookie dough rests and hydrates between batches, it becomes stiffer and spreads less during baking. You may notice a visible difference between the first and second batches baked back to back. To minimize this, refrigerate the dough between batches.

Make-ahead and storage: Rolled cookie dough balls can be stored in heavy-duty zipper-lock bags in the refrigerator for up to 1 week or frozen for up to 6 months. Before baking, let them stand at room temperature until softened to about 21°C (70°F).
Baked cookies are best eaten warm or the day they're made, but leftovers can be stored in an airtight container at room temperature for up to 2 days.
author: Lauren Salkeld
